mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 30 days compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle recession regime, a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle recession regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly payroll employment signals weakening labor market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.3pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment signal severe labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises by at least 0.2pp and PAYEMS declines by at least 0.3% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-stage recession regime, a decline in housing starts signals continued economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the early-stage recession regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines by at least 1% from the previous month.
